''See also: [[Avernus Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Avernus]] [[Incarnation]], also known as [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] of [[Avernus]], is a powerful entity associated with the rarely traveled territory of [[Avernus]]. Physically, she possesses four distinct wings and bronze feathers that function as hair, which are often tied back. Her hands feature talons rather than fingernails. While she has previously been described as a person driven to madness who used mental manipulation to control citizens like puppets, she has also appeared more composed, engaging in conversation and consuming [[tea]]. The process of becoming an [[Incarnation]] is described as a volatile transformation; during the initial stages, the individual is driven by an overwhelming compulsion to act according to their territory, making them extremely dangerous and irrational for a period of time. [[Avernus]] notes that the emergence of [[Incarnations]] is linked to efforts to oppose being sealed away, citing other figures such as the founder of [[Valinhall]] as examples of those who underwent this change.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This entity possesses the face of a human woman paired with the eyes of a bird of prey. Its physical form features four mismatched, colored wings and talons in place of fingernails.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Avernus]] [[Incarnation]] is capable of engaging in intelligible conversation. Its advice is noted for its similarity to the counsel provided by [[Queen]] [[Cynara]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Leah]] draws comparisons between the advice given by [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] and the counsel provided by the [[Avernus]] [[Incarnation]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] possesses the power to see fragments of the future.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|While all others vanished from beneath the [[Hanging Tree|Hanging Trees]], the [[Avernus]] [[Incarnation]] remained as the sole presence. This entity possesses a human woman's face characterized by raptor-like eyes and four mismatched, colored wings. Instead of fingernails, the creature features talons and maintains the ability to engage in intelligible conversation. Beyond its physical form, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] holds the power to perceive fragments of the future, offering advice that has been compared to the counsel of [[Queen]] [[Cynara]].}}
